Short title and commencement

CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part-I, 2nd September, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
2-9-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Customs (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of First Schedule, Act, IV of 1969

CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Customs Act, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part-I, 2nd September, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
2-9-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of First
Schedule, Act, IV of 1969.--In the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), in the
First Schedule,--
(1) In section VI, in Chapter 29,
in heading 2915, against sub-heading 2915.3100, in column (1), in column (3),
for the figure "20" the figure "25" shall be substituted;
(2) In section VII, in Chapter
39, in heading 3919, against sub heading 3919.1000, in column (1), in column
(3), for the figure "20" the figure "25" shall be substituted;
(3) In section X, in Chapter 48,
in heading 4811, against sub-heading 4811.4100, in column (1), in column (3),
for the figure "20" the figure "25" shall be substituted;
(4) In section
XI,--
(a) to Chapter
54,---
(i) in heading
5402, against sub-headings 5402.1000 and 5402.3200 in column (1), in column
(3), for the figure "10" the figure "20" shall be
substituted; and
(ii) in heading
5403, against sub-headings 5403.3100 in column (1), in column (3), for the
figure" 10" the figure "5" shall be substituted-
(b) in Chapter
55, in heading 5509, against sub-headings 5509.1100, 5509.1200, 5509,2100,
5509.2200, 5509.3100, 5505 3200, 5509.4100, 5509.4200, 5509.5100, 5509.5200,
5509.5300, 5509.5900 5509.6100, 5509.6200, 5509.6900, 5509.9100, 5509.9200,
5509.9900, to column (1), in column (3), for the figure "10" the
figure "20" shall be substituted; and
(c) in Chapter
56, against heading 5605.0000, in column (1), in column (3), for the figure
"10" the figure "20" shall be substituted;
(5) in section XVI,
in Chapter 85,--
(a) in heading
8501, against sub-heading 8501.5200 in column (1), in column (3), for the
figure "20" the figure "25" shall be substituted.
(b) in heading
8502, against sub-heading 8502.1110 in column (1), in column (2), for the figure
"10" the figure "5" shall be substituted.
(c) in heading
8502, against sub-heading 8502.1200 in column (1), in column (3), for the
figure "20" the figure "25" shall be substituted.
(d) in heading
8523, against sub-heading 8523.1300 in column (1), in column (3), for the
figure "10" the figure "20" shall be substituted.
(e) in heading
8536, against sub-heading 8536.2010 in column (1), in column (2), the brackets,
figures and words "(500 Volts)" shall be omitted: and
(f) in heading
8502, against sub-heading 8502.1310 in column (1), in column (2), for the
figure "1000" the figure "1100" shall be substituted.
(6) In section
XVII, in Chapter 87, in heading 8711, against sub headings 8711.1000,
8711.2000, 8711.3010, 8711,3090, 8711,4000, 8711.5000 and 8711.9000 in column
(1), in column (3), for the figure "75" the figure "90"
shall be substituted.
(7) In section
XX, in Chapter 96, in heading 9612, against sub headings 9612.1010, in column
(1), in column (3), for the figure "5" the figure "20"
shall be substituted,
(8) In section
XXI, in Chapter 99, in sub-Chapter (1), in heading 9905, in column (1), in
column (2), for the words "United Arab Emirates" the words
"Rules of the United Arab Emirates and" shall be substituted.
